texts: Honestly, I'm quite happy with Motionlab, so this is hard.
The booking works fine for me, I've never had trouble getting a machine.
You just have to plan a bit ahead, that's all.
And I don't think it's expensive, for what you get access to it's a good deal.
What I would improve is communication.
I never know what events are on.
There's the Slack, but it's so full of messages that I just stop reading it.
A short weekly newsletter, one email, with what's happening, that would be perfect.
Oh, and lockers for projects would be nice, I see people dragging stuff around all the time.
Apart from that, keep it as it is.
